card.name: Before Portuguese-language names and places
card.fires_on: Marks a word just before or inside a Portuguese, Brazilian or Lusophone name, such as a comma, 'and', or 's after a place or surname. Appears in web text about Brazil, Portugal, Mozambique or Colombia.

modes.label: Linking marks after names
modes.description: A comma, 'and', or possessive after a name, with another Portuguese-style name coming next.
